Tammi Newcomer joined Riverview Health in 1988 as a critical care nurse and served as the executive director of nursing operations at Riverview Health before becoming the vice president of outpatient services and then Chief Nursing Officer. In her role, Tammi is responsible for overseeing both strategic and operational initiatives that impact nursing practice to ensure patients receive safe, compassionate, high-quality care.
